articles.title: A 17-Year-Old Just Made World Cup History—and He Didn't Even Break a Sweat!
articles.summary: Imagine stepping onto a soccer field with 100,000 fans screaming—and you're only 17! Gilberto Mora did just that for Mexico, becoming the youngest Mexican ever in a World Cup. He completed all 14 passes, cool as a cucumber.

articles.title: You're Already on the Coolest Planet in the Solar System—Here's Why!
articles.summary: Earth is the only planet we know with pizza, puppies, and you! It's just the right temperature for liquid water, has a force field against space rocks, and hides secrets deeper than the moon. Dive into what makes our home so special.

articles.title: Australia: The Only Country That's Also a Whole Continent—and It's Full of Surprises!
articles.summary: Australia is a country and a continent all in one! It's home to kangaroos, the world's largest rock (Uluru), and some of the deadliest spiders. Plus, its people love sports and come from all over the world. Let's explore this wild, wonderful land.
